hash_semantics: Integrity identifier for the specific v0.2 simulation object; not a truth claim.
established_in_model: SOURCE_BLINDNESS: metabolic equivalence does not consume provenance.
CHEMICAL_IDENTITY: matched purified acetate remains the same modeled acetate independent of producer lineage.
CONTEXT_SEPARATION: equal molecular identity does not imply equal physiological-context identity.
MATRIX_SEPARATION: purified acetate is not equivalent to a fermentation broth.
CLAIM_CEILING: the simulation establishes internal consistency only, not in-vivo equivalence.
ENGINEERING_CONSEQUENCE: seek advantage in cost, renewable carbon, purity, controlled flux, separable co-products and downstream C2 utilization rather than biologically superior acetate.

external_evidence.claim_supported: Engineering A. pasteurianus can change acetic-acid production efficiency; combined adhA and pqqABCDE expression reported average productivity 32% above the parental strain.
external_evidence.boundary: This does not imply a distinct molecular species of acetate.

external_evidence.claim_supported: In 12 healthy subjects, specially colon-delivered labelled acetate showed 36 ± 21% systemic availability and acetate-to-butyrate microbial interconversion of about 24%.
external_evidence.boundary: COLONIC_DERIVED_ACETATE_MODEL; not a universal postprandial fraction after ordinary food.

external_evidence.claim_supported: Kombucha fermentation showed dynamic microbial/metabolite composition including biogenic amines.
external_evidence.boundary: Supports BROTH_NE_PURIFIED_ACETATE and process-quality-control requirements; does not establish a clinical effect.

external_evidence.claim_supported: Genetic programming/toolkits for bacterial-cellulose-producing Komagataeibacter are experimentally established.
external_evidence.boundary: Does not validate any specific SCOBY-D0 engineered strain or food use.

claim_ceiling: No human dosing or clinical recommendation.
No claim that engineered provenance improves acetate metabolism.
No claim that acetate is complete nutrition.
No claim that unpurified engineered fermentation broth is safe for consumption.
